translations./garage/brief: A wet slope lengthens braking distance. Choose tires and a driving preference that preserve stopping margin at the bottom.
translations./prediction/heading: Will RO-1 Stop at the Bottom?
translations./prediction/hint: Compare available traction with the braking distance created by speed.
translations./prediction/choices/0/feedback: More friction delays braking-force saturation and shortens stopping distance.
translations./prediction/choices/1/feedback: Braking distance grows with the square of speed. Twice the speed needs about four times the distance at the same traction limit.
translations./running/normal_line: RO-1: Logging slope, body attitude, and traction margin.
translations./debrief/success_summary: The debrief recorded grade, body attitude, slip, and energy throughout the descent.
translations./debrief/failure_summary: Inspect grade, wheel-force saturation, and rollover risk on the timeline, then adjust the build or driving preference.
translations./debrief/evidence_caption: Longitudinal slope, cross-slope, body attitude, and energy use come from the same fixed-step simulation.
translations./debrief/failure_titles/collision-static: Descent failed: left the feasible region
